data.current_description:
Valida si un usuario tiene acceso permitido al gimnasio basándose en su RUT.

El sistema verifica:
- Existencia del usuario en la base de datos
- Membresía activa (status = 'active')
- Fecha de expiración válida (no expirada)
- Opcionalmente, validación por sede específica

Todos los intentos de acceso (exitosos o fallidos) se registran en la base de datos.
data.summary_suggestion: Check user gym access eligibility by RUT
data.description_suggestion: Validates whether a user has active gym membership and is authorized to enter. Requires the user's RUT (Chilean national ID) as input. The system verifies: user existence in database, active membership status, non-expired membership date, and optionally validates against a specific branch/location. Returns access grant or denial with reason. All access attempts (successful or failed) are logged to the database for audit purposes. Requires X-API-Token authentication header.
